title: Speed up outgoing link suggestions on small blogs
description: Step 4/4 is slow: sequential anchor retries, too many candidates, rerank pointless for small blogs, keyword anchors only used as fallback. Parallelize retries, keyword-first, cap candidates by budget, skip rerank when few candidates, log step timings.

title: Revisit dependency upgrades blocked by optimum-onnx pin
description: transformers 4.57.6, sentence-transformers 5.7.0, huggingface-hub 0.36.2, tokenizers 0.22.2 and optimum 2.1.0 are held back (latest: 5.19.0, 6.1.0, 2.1.1, 0.23.2, 2.3.0). Cause: optimum-onnx 0.1.0 (latest) requires optimum~=2.1.0 and transformers<4.58; src/hugin/embeddings.py:176 uses SentenceTransformer(backend='onnx'), which needs it. Options: (1) wait for an optimum-onnx release supporting transformers 5 [safe]; (2) switch to backend='torch' and drop optimum/optimum-onnx/onnx, measuring load time, speed and memory first; (3) run onnxruntime directly (rewrite, not worth it). Also: uv.lock is stale because secrets-resolver is a local package (../jano) with no [tool.uv.sources]; uv sync/lock fail. Rebuild venv with: uv venv --clear && uv pip install -e ../jano -e '.[dev]' --upgrade. Test any upgrade in a separate venv first.

FEASIBILITY STUDY (2026-10-08/09, nothing decided/implemented, no code/epic created): Idea = turn Hugin into a desktop/local 'Hugo sidekick' with a Markdown editor + live preview + integrated media library, to avoid the Hugin -> Pages CMS (tags/images) -> Hugin (AI workflow) round trip. VERDICT: viable, scope reasonable. USER ANSWERS: personal use now, maybe share later; WYSIWYG not required, 'MD editor with live preview + integrated media' is enough; multilingual (translationKey) works perfectly today and must be preserved; images are processed with ~/projects/kpar (Go CLI: WEBP in -> AVIF if smaller; JPG/PNG/HEIC -> WEBP+AVIF keep smallest; deletes original unless --keep; interactive picker when no args) so final format may be AVIF or WEBP.

Hugin sidekick - PROPOSED (not approved) design: reuse Python core as local FastAPI API + web UI; editor CodeMirror 6 (raw text, avoids round-trip diff risk of WYSIWYG) with live preview via background 'hugo server' (faithful to anatole theme); frontmatter form driven by .pages.yml; media: paste/drag -> call kpar as subprocess (no own conversion) -> save to assets/images/YYYY/MM/ -> insert ![alt](/images/YYYY/MM/file). Later wrap in Tauri if sharing. AI features (tags, summary, links, Echo) become editor actions. Plan: (1) spike 1-2 days: open+save 20 real posts with clean git diff + hugo preview; (2) frontmatter form; (3) media library; (4) AI actions.
